new_written_conclusions: For positive integer counts with 11*k<=7*N, N<2*k, and lambda=N*log(2)-k*log(3)>0, N>=10^4000 implies lambda>N^(-21/5).
No nontrivial primitive positive integer cycle in the full critical independent 21-to-12 mask family for 2^21<=N<=10^4000; the external Eliahou input closes smaller periods.
With the identified external inputs, all-period exclusions of independent 22-to-13 masks, alternating-position 21-to-12 masks, and 21-to-12 masks with no cyclic halving-11.
Every surviving full critical integer mask has N>10^4000 and q>N/(24*log_2(N)); for N>=2^16384, N/8192<q<(2*N-3*k)-N/8192.
Every nontrivial positive integer Collatz cycle has odd extrema satisfying 4*M>=9*m+5.

kernel_checked: Cubic polynomial identities and substitution, Bernstein coefficient arithmetic on thirteen contiguous intervals.
Six seed polynomial divisibilities, integral-ratio comparison, coefficient estimate arithmetic, prime-bound and cutoff comparisons.
Generic covered-denominator product bound, minimum window length, and sparse-catalog exponent comparison.
Existing exact Farey cover checker and supporting transition, density, and sparse-family arithmetic.
native_finite_certificates: Four 128-bit dyadic logarithm sums with 64 terms and explicit scaled-tail checks.
32768-bit logarithm sums with 16384 terms and complete denominator cover through 10^4000.
written_not_fully_formalized: All-index partial fractions, zero residue, denominator clearance, positive coefficient growth, integrals, and two-index nonvanishing.
Real-series interpretation of the logarithm enclosures and the explicit logarithm theorem.
Catalog comparisons, extension of the finite cover to 22-to-13 masks, and all-period family exclusions.
Narrow-cycle sorting and transfer to the arbitrary-cycle span bound; entropy and counting in the density application.
scope.python_scope: Finite exact arithmetic, complete independent denominator cover, and sanity checks at indices 1 through 16; the all-index denominator proof is written, not inferred from these examples.
unresolved: No proof or disproof of convergence for every positive integer.
Full independent 21-to-12 masks at unbounded periods, with sufficient transitions, still survive these restrictions.
Arbitrary wider cycles and aperiodic divergent trajectories remain unresolved.
No all-period 8/3 odd-span bound is claimed.
scope.review: The written proof was checked locally against its explicit identities, inequalities, hypotheses, and primary external inputs. No independent peer review or complete Lean formalization of the analytic proof is claimed.
